messages.subject: For Dave Regnery | Climate technology, sustainability and government relations
messages.body:
Dear Trane Technologies Media Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Dave Regnery, Chair and Chief Executive Officer.

Trane Technologies' climate-technology and decarbonisation agenda sits directly at the intersection of public policy, sustainability, customers and industrial transformation. Those priorities align strongly with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a large industrial renewable-energy platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of sustainability, government relations and climate-transition experience might support Trane Technologies' priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Trane Technologies.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
